```{r}
rm(list=ls());gc
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

brfss_before_2010 <- fread("Behavioral_Risk_Factor_Surveillance_System__BRFSS__Prevalence_Data__2010_and_prior_.csv", 
                           select = c("Year", "Locationabbr", "Question", "Break_Out", "Break_Out_Category", "Data_value", "Response"))



brfss_after_2010 <- fread("Behavioral_Risk_Factor_Surveillance_System_(BRFSS)_Prevalence_Data_(2011_to_present)_20260202.csv",
                          select = c("Year", "Locationabbr", "Question", "Break_Out", "Break_Out_Category" , "Data_value","Response"))
```

```{r}
brfss_before_2010_reduce <- brfss_before_2010 |>
  filter(Question %in% c(
    "Adults who have had at least one drink of alcohol within the past 30 days",
    "Do you have any kind of health care coverage?"
  ))

brfss_after_2010_reduce <- brfss_after_2010 |>
  filter(Question %in% c(
    "Adults who have had at least one drink of alcohol within the past 30 days",
    "Do you have any kind of health care coverage?"
  ))

combine_data <- brfss_before_2010_reduce |> bind_rows(brfss_after_2010_reduce)
```



```{r}
alochol_consum <- combine_data |>
  filter(Question %in% c(
    "Adults who have had at least one drink of alcohol within the past 30 days"
  )) |> filter(Break_Out == "Overall" & Response == "Yes")


coverage <- combine_data |>
  filter(!Question %in% c(
    "Adults who have had at least one drink of alcohol within the past 30 days"
  )) |> filter(Break_Out == "Overall" & Response == "Yes")


rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("alochol_consum", "coverage")));gc()

state_pop <- fread("state_population.csv")
```



```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) state_name -> Locationabbr + census region/division
#    this covers all 50 states; add DC explicitly
# ---------------------------------------------------------
state_xwalk <- tibble(
  state_name = c(state.name, "District of Columbia"),
  Locationabbr = c(state.abb, "DC"),
  Census_Region = c(as.character(state.region), "South"),
  Census_Division = c(as.character(state.division), "South Atlantic")
) |> mutate(Census_Region = ifelse(Census_Region == "North Central", "Midwest", Census_Region))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) helper: reduce each dataset to 1 row per state-year using Data_value
#    - if multiple Questions exist, keep the most common one
#    - prefer Overall if present
# ---------------------------------------------------------
to_state_year_value <- function(df, out_name) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.integer(Year),
      Locationabbr = as.character(Locationabbr),
      Data_value = readr::parse_number(as.character(Data_value))
    )

  if ("Question" %in% names(df2)) {
    q_tbl <- df2 %>% count(Question, sort = TRUE)
    if (nrow(q_tbl) > 1) {
      keep_q <- q_tbl$Question[1]
      df2 <- df2 %>% filter(Question == keep_q)
    }
  }

  if ("Break_Out_Category" %in% names(df2)) {
    if (any(tolower(df2$Break_Out_Category) == "overall", na.rm = TRUE)) {
      df2 <- df2 %>% filter(tolower(Break_Out_Category) == "overall")
    }
  }
  if ("Break_Out" %in% names(df2)) {
    if (any(tolower(df2$Break_Out) == "overall", na.rm = TRUE)) {
      df2 <- df2 %>% filter(tolower(Break_Out) == "overall")
    }
  }

  df2 %>%
    group_by(Year, Locationabbr) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(Data_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(!!out_name := value)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) population to (Year, Locationabbr) + region/division
#    your state_pop has: state_fips, state_name, year, population
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pop_state_year <- state_pop %>%
  transmute(
    state_name = as.character(state_name),
    Year = as.integer(year),
    population = as.numeric(population)
  ) %>%
  left_join(state_xwalk, by = "state_name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Locationabbr)) %>%  # keeps 50 states + DC; drops PR/territories if present
  select(Year, Locationabbr, Census_Region, Census_Division, population)

# quick check: do we truly have all states each year?
# (this returns years with < 51 entries)
missing_years <- pop_state_year %>%
  count(Year) %>%
  filter(n < 51)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) build state-year rates
# ---------------------------------------------------------
coverage_state <- to_state_year_value(coverage, "rate_health_care_coverage")
alcohol_state  <- to_state_year_value(alochol_consum, "rate_alochol_consum")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) state-year panel (population + both rates)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
state_year_panel <- pop_state_year %>%
  left_join(coverage_state, by = c("Year", "Locationabbr")) %>%
  left_join(alcohol_state,  by = c("Year", "Locationabbr"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) weighted aggregation to division and region
#    also keep "population_used_*" so you know what weights actually contributed
# ---------------------------------------------------------
division_year_panel <- state_year_panel %>%
  group_by(Year, Census_Region, Census_Division) %>%
  summarise(
    population_total = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),

    population_used_coverage = sum(population[!is.na(rate_health_care_coverage)], na.rm = TRUE),
    rate_health_care_coverage =
      sum(rate_health_care_coverage * population, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(population[!is.na(rate_health_care_coverage)], na.rm = TRUE),

    population_used_alcohol = sum(population[!is.na(rate_alochol_consum)], na.rm = TRUE),
    rate_alochol_consum =
      sum(rate_alochol_consum * population, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(population[!is.na(rate_alochol_consum)], na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Census_Region, Census_Division)

region_year_panel <- state_year_panel %>%
  group_by(Year, Census_Region) %>%
  summarise(
    population_total = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),

    population_used_coverage = sum(population[!is.na(rate_health_care_coverage)], na.rm = TRUE),
    rate_health_care_coverage =
      sum(rate_health_care_coverage * population, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(population[!is.na(rate_health_care_coverage)], na.rm = TRUE),

    population_used_alcohol = sum(population[!is.na(rate_alochol_consum)], na.rm = TRUE),
    rate_alochol_consum =
      sum(rate_alochol_consum * population, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(population[!is.na(rate_alochol_consum)], na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Census_Region)


region_year_panel |> select(-population_total, -population_used_coverage, - population_used_alcohol) |> write_csv("covariate_behavior_region.csv")

division_year_panel|> select(-population_total, -population_used_coverage, - population_used_alcohol, - Census_Region)  |> write_csv("covariate_behavior_division.csv")
```
